main_text.p: רְגְלַיִּין, רְגְלָאֵי, רְגְלָאָה, רְגְלַי Ch. Idem. Plur. רְגְלַיִּין, & Num. 11. 21. in Jon. ubi Veneta male habent רְגְלַיִּין.
ܪܓܠܐ Syr. Torrens, Vadum, quod pede transiri poteft, ܠܐܪܓܠܐ Ad transitum pedis, id est vadum Kedron, Joh. 18. 1.
רָגִיל Ch. Assuetus, expeditus, promptus, Psalm. 45. 2. Plur. רְגִילִין Assueti, Thren. 2. 21.
רָגֻל Chald. Varium, Maculosum pedibus. Plural. רְגוּלִין, רְגוּלַיָּא Genes. 30. 39. 40.
רָגַם Ch. & Syr. Lapidare, lapidibus obruere: Item Sagittis petere, impetere, Thren. 1. 18. Pabel רְגַם Idem, 2. Sam. 16. 6. Esth. 5. 14. Ithpehal אִתְרְגַם Lapidari. Ethpah. Syr. ܐܬܪܓܡ Idem.

רָגַן Ch. Explorare. Idem quod Hebr. רגל, ל & נ inter se comutatis; וַיִּתְרַגְּנוּ יָתָהּ Et explorabunt eam, Deuter. 1. 24. Ex Ithpeh. וַיִּתְרַגָּנוּן לָנָא Et explorabunt nobis, v. 22. in Targ. Jonath.
רְגַע Ch. Momentum, ut Hebr. Eccl. 9. 12. מְרַגְּעָא Ch. Idem, Jobi 21. 13. Juxta alios, Quies, requies.
רְנַף Ithpah. אִתְרְנַף vel Ithpehal אִתְרְנַף Ch. Commoveri, concuti, contremiscere.
רְנַשׁ Ch. & Syr. Tumultuari, tumultuose concurrere, Psalm. 38. 9. Act. 4. 25. Deinde Syr. est Sentire, consentire. Partic: ܣܥܝܪܐ ܠܗܘܢ ܕܝܢ

page.notes: Several Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are set in print and are reproduced only approximately; the Syriac forms in the Partic. and Ethpah. lines and some Hebrew vowel points are doubtful. Printed reading is best checked against the scan.
